text: A repeating key with its own offset on each carved line; a key that starts again at each line; or both. Each leaves exact checks on a pair of alphabets, so every pair of dictionary keyword alphabets is decided through 0244's index.

No forced key is a dictionary or puzzle word, on K4 or any of 50 shuffles. Shortest key that fits some pair on the 24 letters: 15 (offset), 26 (restart), 15 (both); the shuffles' medians are 15, 26, 15.

K4 has more fitting pairs than every shuffle in 4 of 312 cells (restart with offsets, lengths 21 and 23). A shuffle set against the other 49 does that in 2 cells at the median and up to 8, so this is ordinary; replicated on fresh shuffles in 0291.
Plants (random keyword alphabets, a dictionary key word of 7-14 letters, each rule): found 12 of 12. Where more than 10,000 pairs fit, the key was counted, not looked up.
